# Color Swap Puzzle

A simple 4x4 grid puzzle where you swap adjacent colored tiles to make each row a single color.

## How to Play

- Click a tile to select it.
- Click an adjacent tile (up, down, left, right) to swap them.
- The swap count increases with each swap.
- When every row has a single color, the message "Solved!" appears.
- Click **Shuffle** to start a new puzzle.

## Features

- 4x4 grid of colored tiles
- Click two adjacent tiles to swap
- Swap counter
- Win detection
- Shuffle button for new puzzles
- Keyboard accessible (tiles and button are focusable)
- Responsive design for small screens

## Files

- `index.html` – main page
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – game logic
